setting_notes: Ontologies center on outdoor exploration, hazard management, resource foraging, and social interaction in a semi-wild forest/village margin. Verbs and nouns reflect survival, learning, and connection drives, mapping to roles, places, tool types, and major actions from activities. Verb anchors and noun anchors tie consistently to provided primitives.

verbs.gloss: search for and collect wild resources
attend to ongoing phenomena or entities
leave a sign or note in the environment
send out a message or request help
acquire new knowledge from observation or report
identify the position of an entity
apply artifact to achieve a goal
allocate a portion of resources to others
label or distinguish an observed entity
ready an object or self for action
move away from attention or group

nouns.gloss: item that can be eaten or consumed
location where water can be collected
useful object or material for survival
another person in proximity or group
fixed physical location: hut, clearing, etc.
limit of a region or personal space
physical sign left behind (mark, sign, etc)
dense group of bushes or trees
need for rest or reduction in stamina
drinking water sourced from a spring
person not integrated into the main group
active role in discovering new areas
